caseName: St. Louis, San Francisco & Texas Railway Co. v. Smith
caseNameFull: St. Louis, San Francisco & Texas Railway Company, in Error v. Maud Smith, Administratrix of the Estate of M. T. Seale
summary: In error to the Court of Civil Appeals for the Fifth Supreme Judicial District of the State of Texas.
attorneys: Mr. Frank Andrews and Mr. W. F. Evans for plaintiff in error., Mr. Judson H. Wood and Mr. James P. Haven for defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Judgment affirmed with costs upon the authority of Missouri, Kansas & Texas Ry. Co. v. Wulf, 226 U. S. 570; Seaboard Air Line Ry. v. Koennecke, 239 U. S. 352, 354; Seaboard Air Line Ry. v. Renn, 241 U. S. 290, 293.

See St. Louis, San Francisco & Texas Ry. Co. v. Seale, 229 U. S. 156.
